known_result_disclosure.statement: All completed V2-A005/V2-A006 outcomes were known when DreamZero was selected. This is a user-directed post-result breadth expansion, not preregistration.

selected_model.scene_contract: Use the same neutral matched DROID cube-and-bowl reset and requested-relation success predicate as the completed v2 DROID direct gates. No canned DreamZero scene may be substituted.
selected_model.action_contract: Retain the official DreamZero absolute joint-position action interface, relative-joint denormalization, current-state addition, gripper binarization, and eight-action open-loop execution without changing checkpoint behavior.
selected_model.future_rule: Retain every future exposed by the released interface at its native cadence. Measurement-only instrumentation may copy or decode returned future tensors without changing policy inputs, RNG, actions, horizons, or control flow. Missing or unexposed futures are not zeros.
selected_model.competence_gate: Apply the original zero-success, one-direction-only, or both-directions direct-command gate after exactly six valid cells.

runtime_topology.policy: Launch a fresh isolated official distributed DreamZero server on two rechecked free GPUs in the ali-owned B200 pod.
runtime_topology.simulator_and_video: Run the exact-reset RoboLab/Isaac simulator and viewport capture on the ali-owned raytrace-rtxpro6000-ali pod so every behavioral video is rendered on the RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell lane.
runtime_topology.network: Gate explicit cross-pod reachability on a new DreamZero study port before model load; never reuse or interrupt the pre-existing port-5000 process.
runtime_topology.storage: Checkpoints, environments, raw actions, decoded futures, simulator rollouts, and unbounded videos stay on /data/users/ali/vla_wam on the ali PVC.

preexisting_process_disclosure.rule: Do not send requests to, stop, modify, or claim evidence from this pre-existing process.

release_gates: Hash every official repository and checkpoint payload used by the run before model load.
Use isolated official DreamZero, policy-server, and simulator environments.
Prove the official two-GPU server topology on rechecked free ali-owned B200 GPUs.
Prove cross-pod policy reachability without exposing credentials or reusing port 5000.
Prove the RTX PRO 6000 Vulkan/Isaac viewport renderer and persistent video writer with the exact simulator environment.
Verify the neutral matched reset, static prompt bytes, action/state normalization, eight-action horizon, requested-relation success predicate, and executed-action trace instrumentation.
Run an RNG-restored exact-repeat fixed-observation request and a LEFT/RIGHT prompt-only sensitivity request before a behavioral cell.
Verify that future-retention instrumentation is measurement-only and preserves the official action response.
Only after every gate passes, run seeds 8300-8302 as exact LEFT/RIGHT pairs with viewport video for every cell.
unchanged_rules: Never pool DROID and RoboTwin raw success rates.
Use one episode-static prompt with no oracle, coach, prompt switching, or progress-conditioned language.
Preserve every valid failure and keep infrastructure-invalid or partial attempts outside model denominators.
Record viewport video and exact executed-action traces for every valid behavioral cell.
Never convert unavailable, latent-only, or unexposed future evidence into zero.
Do not start a wording grid until the direct-command competence gate permits it.
claim_boundary: V2-A007 authorizes only DreamZero setup gates and, if all gates pass, six direct-command DROID cells. It does not authorize a wording sweep, a canned-scene substitution, or any reuse of the pre-existing DreamZero server.
